purpose: Catalogue of quadcopter calibration actions. The id is the stable backend API key and matches calibration_config.yaml.

sensors.name: Accelerometer
sensors.description: Measures gravity and vehicle tilt. The vehicle is placed in several orientations during calibration.

sensors.name: Gyroscope
sensors.description: Measures rotation. The vehicle must remain motionless while it establishes its bias.

sensors.name: Compass / Magnetometer
sensors.description: Measures magnetic heading. Recalibrate after moving GPS/compass hardware, wiring, or nearby metal.

sensors.name: Level horizon
sensors.description: Stores the physical level position. This is a vehicle setup action, not a separate sensor.

sensors.name: Radio controller inputs
sensors.description: Learns minimum, centre, and maximum values for RC sticks and switches.

sensors.name: Battery voltage monitor
sensors.description: Adjusts voltage scaling to match a multimeter reading.

sensors.name: Battery current monitor
sensors.description: Adjusts current scaling when a current sensor or power module is installed.

sensors.name: ESC throttle range
sensors.description: Used by some PWM/analogue ESCs. Do not use for DShot unless firmware documentation specifically requires it.

sensors.name: Airspeed sensor
sensors.description: Optional; normally used for fixed-wing aircraft rather than a basic quadcopter.

sensors.name: Optical-flow sensor
sensors.description: Optional; only applicable when an optical-flow module is installed.

sensors.name: IMU temperature compensation
sensors.description: Advanced calibration that compensates IMU bias as temperature changes.

notManualCalibration.reason: GPS normally requires configuration and health checks, not manual calibration.
Barometer bias is normally handled automatically by the flight controller.
This must be verified with a motor test; it is not a sensor calibration.
